tools.name: search_treatments
tools.description: Find conditions and treatments documented on ChinaHealth, with links to sourced pages. Does not give medical advice.

tools.name: get_hospital
tools.description: Return sourced facts about one hospital in China (city, international department, documented strengths).

tools.name: get_price_ranges
tools.description: Return price entries for a treatment in China. Each entry has a source, year and verification status. Prices are not quotes.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Return the summary of a ChinaHealth guide on visas, payment, records, insurance, follow-up or clinical trials.
